diagnostics.message: google_bigquery_table.views creates BigQuery views whose query strings (each.value.query) commonly reference tables created by google_bigquery_table.default in the same module. BigQuery resolves/validates a view's query against existing tables at creation time, so a view created before its underlying table exists fails with "Not found: Table". The dependency is not captured because the query is an opaque string with no attribute reference. google_bigquery_table.views should depend on google_bigquery_table.default (e.g. a bare depends_on = [google_bigquery_table.default]).
